rows.note: Use 帶 as the all-purpose verb for taking something with you or having it on your person.

example.english: I always carry an umbrella when I go out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use 搬 for physically moving an object from one place to another, especially a larger one.

example.english: The table is so heavy that only the two of us can carry it.
example.traditional: 張枱咁重，我哋兩個先搬得郁。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 gam3 zung6 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sin1 bun1 dak1 juk1

rows.note: Use 有 for possessing something or for a shop having an item available, rather than for physically carrying it.

example.traditional: 呢間舖頭有冇電池賣㗎？
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 jau5 mou5 din6 ci4 maai6 gaa3

rows.note: Use 陀 for the colloquial pregnancy sense, especially when referring to carrying a baby or twins.

example.jyutping: to4 maa1 toi1 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3
